title: Antelope Reef 1490ac — 베트남 공식 항의, 활주로·헬기장·50+ 건물
snippet: China's Antelope Reef reclamation reaches 1490 acres, approaching Mischief Reef (1504ac) as largest SCS outpost. NW straightened edge suitable for 9000ft airstrip. Helipad, 50+ small gray-roofed structures, jetties visible. Vietnam issued rare formal objection. First significant SCS island-building since 2017.
tag_reason: Major update with Vietnam formal protest (new diplomatic escalation) + detailed structural analysis. Previous coverage was generic; this has specific imagery analysis of airstrip/structures.
